sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Test setup and image route loading
sections.what: Imports the lab functions, the money-term checker and the test database helper, then loads the image route once for all tests.
sections.why: Loads the image route once so each test can call it directly.
sections.watch_out: The route is loaded by its file path, so moving or renaming it breaks this whole file.

sections.name: get
sections.title: Request helper for the image
sections.what: Builds a request for a call's image address and returns the response from the image route.
sections.why: Avoids repeating the request setup in each test.
sections.watch_out: The helper must match how the route expects its parameters, or every image test fails.

sections.name: “Called it” share cards (og)
sections.title: Share card checks
sections.what: Checks that a graded call's card shows only the display name, a point grade with a sign, the heading CALLED IT, and a provisional calibration label, and never the pick itself, email, identifier or money wording. Checks that the image is a 1200 by 630 PNG, cached for a day, and that ungraded or unknown calls return nothing.
sections.why: Likely reason: the card must be safe to share and must not give away the best answer to the moment being graded.
sections.watch_out: The evidence image is written when the EVIDENCE setting is on, so leave it off in ordinary runs.

summary: Tests the shareable "Called it" card: the text data and the image a user can share after a graded prediction.
purpose: Checks that a shared card shows only safe, public information and that the image is a correctly sized PNG.
why: Likely reason: the card is shared outside the app, so it must not reveal the user's email, identifier, the best option, or money wording.
how: Creates a user with two calls on different moments, one graded and one not. Then checks the card's text fields, that the card is hidden for ungraded or unknown calls, and that the image route returns a PNG of the right size with a one-day cache setting.
inputs: A test user and two locked calls created in a test database, plus requests to the image route.
outputs: Pass or fail results. When the EVIDENCE setting is on, a PNG file is written into the docs folder.
risks: Writing the evidence image during tests changes files in the docs folder. A change to the card fields could leak private data, which the tests guard against.
debug: If the image test fails, check the response status and the image size bytes. If the card text test fails, compare the card's fields with the privacy rules listed in the test.
